walkthrough: Goal: see my practice at a glance, what I did each day and how far I have come, without the app counting the hours it lay open while I did something else, and without days in a row to keep.

Before any practice: the gallery's Today card shows the stage's road, fifteen small pencil rings on a dashed line, the first ringed in ink, and Start practice at its foot. A tap on the card (not on Start practice) opens the practice book, grown out of the card: Gallery at the top left, Practice book in the middle, at the right quietly 0 sessions · 0 min. Under it the road through V大's eight stages: stage 1 at the left by name (Lines and colours), its fifteen sessions along a long stretch, the first ringed with Next above it; stage 2 by name, stages 3 to 8 by number, all in pencil. Below, October as a calendar, Monday first, the 5th ringed: today. Nothing else: nothing done yet. Gallery puts the book back into the card.

Monday 5 October: Start practice. I copy the first line and compare it, skip to the first colour, pick it on the wheel, fill and compare, a few minutes at each, then Finish. The card at the right says Session 1 done; above its counts the stage's road: the first dot inks in, two faint rings spreading from it, then a vermilion seal stamps down under it, FIRST STEP (初练 in Chinese), New seal · First session under it. Gallery: the Today card's road has its first dot inked and the second ringed.

Tuesday 6 October (I left the app overnight): Start practice. The warm-up's line: I draw it after a moment, compare after three minutes; then I put the tablet down with the app open for two hours. Back, Next to the warm-up's colour: I pick and fill it after two minutes, compare a minute later, and go back to the gallery.

The book: at the right 1 session · 15 min or so. The calendar: the 5th and the 6th each an ink wash behind its number, the 6th ringed (today). Beside it the colour's first pick of session 1 as a point with its ΔE × 100 written over it; Session 1's first line beside Session 2's warm-up line, each its original in thin see-through red with my ink copy over it; the FIRST STEP seal. The 6th tapped: its card grows out of it over that side: Tuesday 6 October, a few minutes (the two hours count nothing), Session 2's sheet small, and the warm-up colour I matched as a square split corner to corner, the original above the diagonal and mine below. The 5th: Session 1's sheet with my line and colour, and its colour pair. Session 1's sheet tapped opens it, done, its summary at the right: the dot and the seal already in place.

Wednesday 7 October: Continue practice. Next to the warm-up's second line; I draw it, leave the app half an hour (it counts nothing), come back, compare, and go on to Finish. The second dot inks in; no seal this time. The Today card's road has two dots inked.

The book: three days washed, each by its time; a swipe to the right across the calendar shows September (empty); Later month brings October back. The 7th tapped shows Session 2's sheet again (painted over two days, it shows on both). The back button puts the book back into the Today card.

Not here: a colour copy painted over two days and a record from before 1.7.0 timed by its compares (the practice crate's and the store's tests); the 100 lines and 100 colours, ten-session and stage seals (the seals' tests).
